Computed order = average rank across 7 people sources (missing = list length + 5): Piano 1.50, Guitar 2.43, Drums 5.14, Violin 5.43, Saxophone 6.29, Electric Guitar 8.86, Flute 9.43, Trumpet 10.07, Ukulele 10.14, Bass Guitar 11.93, Banjo 12.43, Cello 13.36, Clarinet 14.36, then Theremin 14.43 (Wikipedia-only), Recorder 14.57, Accordion 14.79, Double Bass 15.14 (Wiki-only), Mandolin 15.29 (Wiki-only), Harmonica 15.43, Harp 15.57, Synthesizer 16.29, Viola 16.57, Didgeridoo/Harpsichord ~16.6 (Wiki-only), Keyboard 16.86, Trombone 16.86, Bagpipes 17.0, ... Piano stays #1 over Guitar: it leads 4 of 7 sources (YouGov learned 29% vs 18%, YouGov wish 47% vs 22%, both OnePoll lists); acoustic and electric guitar kept separate because YouGov and OnePoll measure them separately (alias 'guitar' only on Guitar, 'electric' only on Electric Guitar, 'bass' only on Bass Guitar). Gut-check moves: Harmonica computed #19 -> #14 (YouGov learned 6% ranks it #12 and wish 1% ties it with ukulele/cello; only Wikipedia pageviews put it low; it is a classic free-recall instrument). Clarinet stays #13 (just below the gut 12; YouGov wish 0% and Wikipedia put it lower). All other gut-check items land in the top 12. Tail judgments: Wikipedia-only curiosity items (Theremin, Didgeridoo, Harpsichord, Lute, Sitar, Synthesizer) dropped; global reading curiosity is not what a typical US adult names, and none appears in any poll; synth folded into Keyboard as alias, double/upright bass folded into Bass Guitar as aliases (YouGov 'Bass' 3% was merged too). Harp moved to #15 (4 sources incl. search 74K). Trombone #26 -> #16 and Keyboard #25 -> #19 (each in 3 sources: YouGov learned 3% / 9% electric piano; famous band/home instruments). Recorder #17, Accordion #18 per data. Viola #21, Mandolin #22 (296K pageviews, Wiki-only), Bagpipes #24 (232K pageviews, Wiki-only).
confidence: High for 1-5 (Piano, Guitar, Drums, Violin, Saxophone backed by 7 sources); medium for 6-14; low-medium for 15-24, where ordering leans on YouGov's ever-learned list plus Wikipedia pageviews and judgment. Caveats: Piano vs Guitar at #1 is close in spirit (guitar wins sexiest and ties search); polls 2014-2022; no Ranker data (blocked); Wikipedia is global and curiosity-skewed so it was not followed strictly in the tail.
